name: beacon_score
description: Score a list of connection times for periodicity: median interval, jitter, how tightly the intervals cluster, and whether the pattern stopped. Takes times from pcap_summary, a proxy log, a firewall log or anywhere else.

timestamps.description: Connection start times: epoch seconds, or ISO 8601 strings

label.description: What this series is, carried into the result

min_events.description: Refuse to score fewer than this many (default 6)
